title: Socket.IO Envelope
description: The custom message envelope used for every Socket.IO message between the MCP server and its clients (REAPER extension, mobile PWA). The type follows a namespace:action convention. Payload contents are validated separately by the schema registered for the specific message type.

type.description: Message type in namespace:action form — for example state:prompt, request:transport, response:project_context, confirm:approve, stream:response, script:download, error:validation. The namespace is enumerated rather than left open so that an invented or misspelled one is rejected at the envelope rather than reaching a dispatcher with no handler for it.

payload.description: Message body. The shape depends on the message type and is validated against the schema registered for that type.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier linking a request:* envelope to its response:* envelope. Generated as a UUIDv4 by the server for tool relay requests.
